description: Shell types finalize into safe registered base codecs with arrays, catalogs, defaults, and PostgreSQL operator boundaries
cleanup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS diff_base_rows CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS diff_exact_text CASCADE;
sql: SELECT typtype, typisdefined, typarray = 0 AS no_array_before_definition FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'diff_exact_text';
CREATE FUNCTION diff_exact_text_in(cstring) RETURNS diff_exact_text AS 'textin' LANGUAGE internal IMMUTABLE STRICT;
CREATE FUNCTION diff_exact_text_out(diff_exact_text) RETURNS cstring AS 'textout' LANGUAGE internal IMMUTABLE STRICT;
CREATE FUNCTION diff_exact_text_recv(internal) RETURNS diff_exact_text AS 'textrecv' LANGUAGE internal IMMUTABLE STRICT;
CREATE FUNCTION diff_exact_text_send(diff_exact_text) RETURNS bytea AS 'textsend' LANGUAGE internal IMMUTABLE STRICT;

CREATE TYPE diff_exact_text (INPUT=diff_exact_text_in, OUTPUT=diff_exact_text_out, RECEIVE=diff_exact_text_recv, SEND=diff_exact_text_send, INTERNALLENGTH=variable, ALIGNMENT=int4, STORAGE=extended, CATEGORY='S', DEFAULT='seed', DELIMITER=';', COLLATABLE=true);

SELECT typtype, typisdefined, typcategory, typarray <> 0 AS has_array, typinput::regproc::text, typoutput::regproc::text, typreceive::regproc::text, typsend::regproc::text, typdelim, typcollation <> 0 AS collatable FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'diff_exact_text';
CREATE TABLE diff_base_rows (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, value diff_exact_text, values_array diff_exact_text[]);
SELECT value, values_array, pg_typeof(value), pg_typeof(values_array) FROM diff_base_rows ORDER BY id;
